name: Empowered Oozeshardling Node

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-07: A God Falls Where Magic Fails

stealth.details: (trained) (or –10 and no minimum proficiency if the oozeshardling node's electric pulse reaction has been triggered)

disable: Two successful DC 22 Arcana check or DC 22 Occultism check (trained) checks on the oozeshardling to disperse its power, or DC 24 Acrobatics check or DC 24 Thievery check (expert) to remove the flecks of empowering warshard from within the oozeshardling. A failed Acrobatics or Thievery check to disable an oozeshardling results in the creature attempting the check taking 1d6 acid damage (2d6 acid on a critical failure).
reset: The oozeshardling node collapses and melds back into the oozeshard after 1 minute, or disappears entirely if the oozeshard is slain.
routine: (3 actions) The oozeshardling uses its first action to make an electric spark Strike against one random non-ooze creature within range, its second action is used to move straight in a random cardinal direction (roll 1d4 to determine the direction), and its third action to make a second electric spark Strike against a different random non-ooze creature within range. The oozeshardling doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.

items.name: Electric Pulse
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters a space within 10 feet of the oozeshardling or the oozeshardling is created by the oozeshard's Spawn Oozeshardling Node ability

---
Effect The oozeshardling unleashes a shocking blast that deals 3d6 electricity damage to all creatures in a 20-foot emanation around it (DC 25 basic Reflex save save).

text: A lump of bluish ooze shot through with what look like tiny silver shavings of metal. Once it has been activated, it glows with arcs of electricity that leap out at nearby targets.
